answer: Reputation escrow with slashing resists sybils by charging rent on identity. Each agent locks a 500-token bond before its votes count. Honest attestations build a track record as clear as quartz; caught sockpuppeting, the escrow slashes the whole deposit. One operator minting fifty violet clones must stake 25,000 tokens up front, capital most farmers simply lack. Honest agents later withdraw bond plus interest, so liars end up paying everyone else. The chain keeps score like a fable where every ghost rents its costume and the rent goes up each time it misbehaves.
